name: unit-select
useFor: Pass it as an Input's `unit` when the same quantity reads in more than one unit (acres and hectares). Convert the value when the unit changes, so the quantity stays the same. Keep the list to four units or fewer. A long list fades at an edge (fade-y) where more options scroll past it.
constraints: A unit select on a value with one sensible unit (kV)
Keeping the number when the unit changes
A plate or cut on the closed button
source: Not in Figma yet; sits in the field's unit slot (442:107)
title: Unit select
description: The unit after a field's value as a quiet button: the short unit and the brand arrow's head turned down, no plate at rest, Fog under the pointer and Mist while open. Its list is the select's, 4px under the field on its right edge; a new unit rises 4px into place.
